name: Kalima Tayyibah
arabic: لا إله إلا الله محمد رسول الله
meaning: Allah alone; Muhammad ﷺ His Messenger

name: Kalima Shahadah
arabic: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله
meaning: Declaration of faith

name: Tawbah
arabic: أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه
meaning: Repentance to Allah

name: Durood / Salawat
arabic: اللهم صل على محمد
meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ﷺ

name: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
arabic: إنا لله وإنا إليه راجعون
meaning: Indeed, we belong to Allah and to Him we will return

name: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
arabic: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير
meaning: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and all praise, and He has power over everything

name: Astaghfirullahal Azim
arabic: أستغفر الله العظيم
meaning: Seeking Allah's forgiveness

name: Astaghfirullahal Azim alladhi la ilaha illa Huwal Hayyul Qayyum wa atubu ilayh
arabic: أستغفر الله العظيم الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب إليه
meaning: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him

name: Rabbighfir li wa tub alayya, innaka Antat Tawwabur Rahim
arabic: رب اغفر لي وتب علي إنك أنت التواب الرحيم
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance

name: Sayyidul Istighfar
arabic: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت، خلقتني وأنا عبدك، وأنا على عهدك ووعدك ما استطعت، أعوذ بك من شر ما صنعت، أبوء لك بنعمتك علي وأبوء بذنبي، فاغفر لي، فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت
meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord. Forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You

name: SubhanAllahi walhamdulillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar
arabic: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر
meaning: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest

name: SubhanAllahi walhamdulillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
arabic: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Sallallahu alayhi wa sallam
arabic: صلى الله عليه وسلم
meaning: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him

name: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad
arabic: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد
meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

name: Durood Ibrahim
arabic: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد، اللهم بارك على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما باركت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد
meaning: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family as You blessed Ibrahim and his family

name: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah
arabic: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له
meaning: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner

name: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu
arabic: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: HasbiyAllahu la ilaha illa Huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul Arshil Azim
arabic: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم
meaning: Allah is sufficient for me; upon Him I rely

name: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an
arabic: اللهم إني أسألك علما نافعا
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge

name: Allahumma inni as'aluka rizqan tayyiban
arabic: اللهم إني أسألك رزقا طيبا
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for good and lawful provision

name: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir
arabic: رب إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير
meaning: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send me

name: Rabbi yassir wa la tu'assir
arabic: رب يسر ولا تعسر
meaning: My Lord, make it easy and do not make it difficult

name: Rabbi ishrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri
arabic: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري
meaning: My Lord, expand my chest and make my task easy

name: Allahumma ajurni fi musibati wakhluf li khayran minha
arabic: اللهم أجرني في مصيبتي واخلف لي خيرا منها
meaning: O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better

name: Rabbir hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
arabic: رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا
meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me

name: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya
arabic: رب اغفر لي ولوالدي
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my parents

name: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lilmuttaqina imama
arabic: ربنا هب لنا من أزواجنا وذرياتنا قرة أعين واجعلنا للمتقين إماما
meaning: Our Lord, grant us comfort from our spouses and children

name: Ihdinas siratal mustaqim
arabic: اهدنا الصراط المستقيم
meaning: Guide us to the straight path

name: Allahumma ihdini
arabic: اللهم اهدني
meaning: O Allah, guide me

name: Allahumma inni as'alukal huda wat-tuqa wal-afafa wal-ghina
arabic: اللهم إني أسألك الهدى والتقى والعفاف والغنى
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and contentment

name: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim
arabic: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم
meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed

name: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
arabic: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق
meaning: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil He created

name: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-Alim
arabic: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء وهو السميع العليم
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Ayatul Kursi
arabic: آية الكرسي
meaning: The Verse of the Throne

name: Surah Al-Ikhlas
arabic: سورة الإخلاص
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Surah Al-Falaq
arabic: سورة الفلق
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Surah An-Nas
arabic: سورة الناس
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Raditu billahi Rabban wa bil-Islami dinan wa bi Muhammadin Nabiyya
arabic: رضيت بالله ربا وبالإسلام دينا وبمحمد نبيا
meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet

name: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
arabic: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا
meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live

name: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
arabic: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعدما أماتنا وإليه النشور
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirihi
arabic: بسم الله في أوله وآخره
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Bismillahi walajna wa bismillahi kharajna wa ala Rabbina tawakkalna
arabic: بسم الله ولجنا وبسم الله خرجنا وعلى ربنا توكلنا
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Bismillahi tawakkaltu alAllah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
arabic: بسم الله توكلت على الله، لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik
arabic: اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
arabic: اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Ghufranak
arabic: غفرانك
meaning: I seek Your forgiveness

name: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar
arabic: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka Antas-Sami'ul-Alim
arabic: ربنا تقبل منا إنك أنت السميع العليم
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa illam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin
arabic: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minan-nar
arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من النار
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the Fire

name: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
arabic: الحمد لله الذي أطعمني هذا ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة
meaning: Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided this

name: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal khubthi wal-khaba'ith
arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الخبث والخبائث
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil and impure beings

name: Ashhadu alla ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh
arabic: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Dua after Adhan
arabic: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة والصلاة القائمة آت محمدا الوسيلة والفضيلة وابعثه مقاما محمودا الذي وعدته
meaning: Supplication after hearing the Adhan

name: Dua for Anxiety and Sadness
arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الهم والحزن، وأعوذ بك من العجز والكسل، وأعوذ بك من الجبن والبخل، وأعوذ بك من غلبة الدين وقهر الرجال
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow

name: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana milladunka rahmah, innaka Antal Wahhab
arabic: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة إنك أنت الوهاب
meaning: Dhikr and supplication

name: Dua for Increase in Knowledge
arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

name: Dua of Prophet Yunus
arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
meaning: There is no deity except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly been among the wrongdoers.

name: Dua of Prophet Ayyub
arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
meaning: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

name: Dua of Prophet Zakariya
arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
meaning: My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of inheritors.

name: Dua for Forgiveness
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
meaning: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

name: Dua for Safety from Wrongdoers
arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

name: Dua to Establish Prayer
arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
meaning: My Lord, make me and my descendants steadfast in prayer. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

name: Dua for All Believers
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
meaning: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day the judgment is established.

name: Dua of the People of the Cave
arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
meaning: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and guide us rightly through our ordeal.

name: Dua for Patience and Victory
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, shower us with patience, make our feet firm, and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.

name: Dua for Gratitude and Righteous Deeds
arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
meaning: My Lord, inspire me to be thankful for Your blessings upon me and my parents, and to do good deeds that please You.

name: Dua for a Home in Paradise
arabic: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ
meaning: My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise.

name: Dua for Light and Forgiveness
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
meaning: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. You are truly Most Capable of everything.

name: Dua for Acceptance and Repentance
arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
meaning: Our Lord, accept this from us and turn to us in mercy. You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful.

name: Dua for Complete Forgiveness
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
meaning: Our Lord, do not punish us if we forget or make a mistake.

name: Dua for a Pure Heart toward Believers
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and the believers before us, and leave no bitterness in our hearts toward those who believe.

name: Dua against the Whispers of Shaytan
arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils, and from their presence.

name: Dua for Mercy and Forgiveness
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.

name: Dua for Protection from Hell
arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
meaning: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Its punishment is truly unrelenting.

name: Dua for an Honourable Entrance and Exit
arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا
meaning: My Lord, grant me an honourable entrance and exit, and give me supporting authority from Yourself.

name: Dua of Those Seeking Forgiveness
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
meaning: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive our sins and protect us from the Fire.

name: Dua for Faith and Steadfastness
arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, we believe in what You revealed and follow the messenger, so count us among the witnesses.

name: Dua for Patience and Submission
arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims in submission to You.

name: Dua for Protection from Persecution
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a target of persecution by the wrongdoers, and save us by Your mercy.

name: Dua for Wisdom and Good Reputation
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
meaning: My Lord, grant me wisdom, join me with the righteous, and bless me with honourable mention.

name: Dua to Be Grateful and Righteous
arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
meaning: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful, to do good that pleases You, and make my descendants righteous.

name: Dua for Trust and Repentance
arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
meaning: Our Lord, in You we trust, to You we turn, and to You is the final return.

name: Dua for a Bearable Burden
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ
meaning: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear.

name: Dua for Pardon, Forgiveness and Mercy
arabic: وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا
meaning: Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Guardian.

name: Dua after Hearing the Call to Faith
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
meaning: Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith, so we believed.

name: Before Sleeping 1
arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
meaning: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.

name: Before Sleeping 2
arabic: اللّٰہُمَّ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللّٰہُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
meaning: O Allah, You have created my soul and it is for You to take it in death. Its death and its life are in Your Hand. If You cause it to live then protect it and if You cause it to die then forgive it. O Allah, I ask you to keep me safe and sound.

name: Before Sleeping 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
meaning: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.

name: When you wake up 1
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
meaning: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

name: When you wake up 2
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
meaning: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.

name: When you wake up 3
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ، سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ  رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, with no partner or associate. His is the dominion and all praise is to Him, and He is Able to do all things. Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, none has the right to be worshiped but Allah, Allah is the Most Great, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Supreme. O Lord, forgive me.

name: After leaving toilet
arabic: غُفۡرَانَکَ
meaning: I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.

name: When starting ablution
arabic: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ
meaning: In the name of Allah.

name: When completing ablution
arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
meaning: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.

name: When Leaving Home
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ
meaning: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.’ slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally

name: Upon Entering Home
arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللّٰهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
meaning: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

name: When going up the Stairs / Ascending a high place
arabic: اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
meaning: Allah is the Most Great!

name: When coming down of Stairs / Descending from high place
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰه
meaning: Glory be to Allah

name: For travel
arabic: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِیۡ سَخَّرَ لَنَا ہٰذَا وَ مَا کُنَّا لَہٗ مُقۡرِنِیۡنَ  ۙ  وَ اِنَّا اِلٰی رَبِّنَا لَمُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ
meaning: Glory unto Him Who created this transportation, for us, though we were unable to create it on our own. And unto our Lord we shall return.

name: While returning from travel
arabic: اللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ ، اللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ ، اللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ،  لَهُ الْمُلْكُ،  وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ،  وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ،  آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ،  صَدَقَ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
meaning: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.

name: When night approaches during Travel
arabic: يَا أَرْضُ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكِ اللّٰهُ أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ شَرِّكِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيكِ وَشَرِّ مَا خُلِقَ فِيكِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَدِبُّ عَلَيْكِ وَأَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْ أَسَدٍ وَأَسْوَدَ وَمِنَ الْحَيَّةِ وَالْعَقْرَبِ وَمِنْ سَاكِنِ الْبَلَدِ وَمِنْ وَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
meaning: O earth, my Lord and your Lord is Allah; I seek refuge in Allah from your evil, the evil of what you contain, the evil of what has been created in you, and the evil of what creeps upon you; I seek refuge in Allah from lions, from large black snakes, from other snakes, from scorpions, from the evil of jinn which inhabit a settlement, and from a parent and his offspring.

name: For accommodation
arabic: رَّبِّ اَنۡزِلۡنِیۡ مُنۡزَلًا مُّبٰرَکًا وَّ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِیۡنَ
meaning: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].

name: After finishing a meal
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
meaning: Praise be to Allah Who has fed us and given us drink and made us Muslims.

name: When given a drink
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَأَسْقِ مَنْ أَسْقَانِي
meaning: O Allah! Feed him who fed me and give him drink who gave me to drink.

name: Upon drinking milk
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
meaning: O Allah! Bless us in it and give us increase of it.

name: When dining at someone's house
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
meaning: O Allah! Bless them in what You have provided for them, and forgive them and have Mercy on them.

name: When opening your fast 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
meaning: O Allah! For You I have fasted and upon your provision, I have broken my fast.

name: When opening your fast 2
arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ
meaning: Thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is certain if Allaah wills.

name: For someone who provides you with Iftar
arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأَبْرَارُ وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
meaning: May the fasting (men) break their fast with you, and the pious eat your food, and the angels pray for blessing on you.

name: While wearing clothes
arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
meaning: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power or might from myself.

name: When wearing new clothes
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
meaning: O Allah, praise is to You. You have clothed me. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what it has been made for, and I seek Your protection from the evil of it and the evil of what it has been made for.

name: When looking into the mirror
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
meaning: O Allah! You have given me good physical shape so grant me a good attitude.

name: During Athan
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
meaning: There is no might and no power except by Allah.

name: After Listening Athan
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدَا  ۣ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودَا  ۣ  الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
meaning: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer. Grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the honored station You have promised him.

name: After Takbeer (Start of prayer) 1
arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلاَتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏.‏ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاَقِ لَا يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لَا يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
meaning: I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate (others with Allah). Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You

name: After Takbeer (Start of prayer) 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَاىَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ وَالْبَرَدِ
meaning: O Allah! separate me from my sins as You have separated the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my transgressions as the white garment is cleansed of stains. O Allah! wash away my sins with ice and water and frost.

name: After Takbeer (Start of prayer) 3
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ،  وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ،  وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ،  وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
meaning: Glory is to You O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your Name and Exalted is Your Majesty. There is none worthy of worship but You.

name: During Ruku (bowing down in prayer) 1
arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
meaning: Glory to my Lord the Exalted.

name: During Ruku (bowing down in prayer) 2
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
meaning: Glory is to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise is Yours. O Allah, forgive me.

name: During Ruku (bowing down in prayer) 3
arabic: سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
meaning: Glory (to You), Most Holy (are You), Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

name: During Ruku (bowing down in prayer) 4
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي
meaning: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I have believed and to You I have submitted. My hearing, my sight, my brain, my bones and my sinews submit to You.

name: During Ruku (bowing down in prayer) 5
arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ
meaning: Glory is to You, Master of power, of dominion, of majesty and greatness.

name: While prostrating before Allah (in Sujood) 1
arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى
meaning: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.

name: While prostrating before Allah (in Sujood) 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللّٰهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
meaning: O Allah, to You I prostrate myself and in You I believe. To You I have submitted. My face is prostrated to the One Who created it, fashioned it, and gave it hearing and sight. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.

name: While prostrating before Allah (in Sujood) 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَاَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
meaning: O Allah, I seek protection in Your pleasure from Your anger, and I seek protection in Your forgiveness from Your punishment. I seek protection in You from You. I cannot count Your praises. You are as You have praised Yourself.

name: While prostrating before Allah (in Sujood) 4
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
meaning: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, great and small, the first and the last, those that are apparent and those that are hidden.

name: When sitting between two Sujood (Prostrations) 1
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
meaning: Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.

name: When sitting between two Sujood (Prostrations) 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, heal me, and provide for me.

name: Prostration during Quran Recitation
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
meaning: O Allah, write it as a reward for me, and release me from a burden for it, and make it a I treasure for me in Paradise. Accept it from me as You accepted it from your servant Dawud.

name: When sitting in Prayer (Tashahhud)
arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللّٰهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
meaning: All greetings of humility are for Allah, and all prayers and goodness. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.

name: Darood-e-Ibraheem
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
meaning: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.

name: After Tashahhud 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ،  وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ،  وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ  اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.

name: After Tashahhud 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
meaning: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and no one forgives sins but You. So, grant me forgiveness and have mercy on me. Surely, you are Forgiving, Merciful.

name: After Tashahhud 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ،  وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ،  وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ،  وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ،  وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ،  وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلهَ إِلَاَّ أَنْتَ
meaning: O Allah, forgive me what I have sent before me and what I have left behind me, what I have concealed and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess, and what You are better aware of than I . You are the One Who sends forth and You are the One Who delays . There is none worthy of worship but You.

name: Dua e Qunoot (recited in Witr prayer) 1
arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْتَعِيْنُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَنُثْنِىْ عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ وَنَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ وَنَخْلَعُ وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ یَّفْجُرُكَ. اَللَّهُمَّ اِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَلَكَ نُصَلِّئ وَنَسْجُدُ وَاِلَيْكَ نَسْعٰى ونَحْفِدُ ونَرْجُوْا رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشٰى عَذَابَكَ اِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
meaning: O Allah! We implore You for help and beg forgiveness of You and believe in You and rely on You and extol You and we are thankful to You and are not ungrateful to You and we alienate and forsake those who disobey You. O Allah! You alone do we worship and for You do we pray and prostrate and we betake to please You and present ourselves for the service in Your cause and we hope for Your mercy and fear Your chastisement. Undoubtedly, Your torment is going to overtake infidels O Allah!

name: Dua e Qunoot (recited in Witr prayer) 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ
meaning: O Allah, You alone do we worship and to You we pray and bow down prostrate. To You we hasten to worship and to serve. Our hope is for Your mercy and we fear Your punishment. Surely, Your punishment of the disbelievers is at hand. O Allah, we seek Your help and Your forgiveness, and we praise You beneficently. We do not deny You and we believe in You. We surrender to You and renounce whoever disbelieves in You.

name: Dua e Qunoot (recited in Witr prayer) 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ وَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
meaning: O Allah, guide me among those Thou hast guided, grant me security among those Thou hast granted security, take me into Thy charge among those Thou hast taken into Thy charge, bless me in what Thou hast given, guard me from the evil of what Thou hast decreed, for Thou dost decree, and nothing is decreed for Thee. He whom Thou befriendest is not humbled. Blessed and Exalted art Thou, our Lord.

name: After Fajr Prayer
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً،  وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً،  وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision, and deeds that will be accepted.

name: After Salah (Prayer) Tasbeeh
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ  (33 times) الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہ  (33 times) اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَر  (34 times)
meaning: Glory be to Allah (33 times), Praise be to Allah (33 times), Allah is the greatest (34 times)

name: After Prayer Remembrances 1
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ (ثَلاثاً). اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
meaning: I ask Allah for forgiveness.(three times) "O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour." (AS-Salam: The One Who is free from all defects and deficiencies.)

name: After Prayer Remembrances 2
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
meaning: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.

name: After Prayer Remembrances 3
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين). لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
meaning: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest.’ (thirty-three times) None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

name: After Prayer Remembrances 4
arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ اَلۡحَیُّ الۡقَیُّوۡمُ لَا تَاۡخُذُہٗ سِنَۃٌ وَّ لَا نَوۡمٌ  لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مَنۡ ذَا الَّذِیۡ یَشۡفَعُ عِنۡدَہٗۤ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِہٖ  یَعۡلَمُ مَا بَیۡنَ اَیۡدِیۡہِمۡ وَ مَا خَلۡفَہُمۡ  وَ لَا یُحِیۡطُوۡنَ بِشَیۡءٍ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِہٖۤ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ کُرۡسِیُّہُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ  وَ لَا یَـُٔوۡدُہٗ حِفۡظُہُمَا  وَ ہُوَ الۡعَلِیُّ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
meaning: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

name: After Prayer Remembrances 5
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحَدْهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ،  لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ . (عَشْر مَرّات بَعْدَ المَغْرِب)
meaning: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent. (ten times after the Maghrib Prayer)

name: After Prayer Remembrances 6
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً . (بَعْد السّلامِ من صَلاةِ الفَجْر)
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable. (To be said after giving salam for the Fajr Prayer)

name: Offer Salah regularly
arabic: اِنَّ رَبِّیۡ لَسَمِیۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ ، رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مُقِیۡمَ الصَّلٰوۃِ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ ، رَبَّنَا وَ تَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
meaning: Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

name: When going to the Masjid
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ  فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا،  وَاجْعَلْ  فِي لِسَانِي نُورًا،  وَاجْعَلْ  فِي سَمْعِي نُورًا،  وَاجْعَلْ  فِي بَصَرِي نُورًا،  وَاجْعَلْ  خَلْفِي نُورًا،  وَأَمَامِي نُورًا،  وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا،  وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا ،   اللَّهُمَّ وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا
meaning: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my eyesight, light on my right hand, light on my left hand, light in front of me, light behing me, light below me, O Allah, give me abundant light.

name: Upon entering Masjid 1
arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
meaning: In the name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive me my sins and open the gates of Your mercy for me.

name: Upon entering Masjid 2
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
meaning: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil

name: Upon Leaving Masjid 1
arabic: [اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
meaning: [Prayers and Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah]. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour.

name: Upon Leaving Masjid 2
arabic: [اَلصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ]  اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
meaning: [Prayers and Peace be upon the Messenger of Allah]. O Allah, protect me from the accursed Shaitan.

name: Morning Remembrance 1
arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِيْ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِيْ النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِيْ الْقَبْرِ
meaning: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

name: Morning Remembrance 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
meaning: O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and to You is our return.

name: Morning Remembrance 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ،  خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ،  وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ،  أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ،  أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ،  وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.

name: Morning Remembrance 4
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا نُشْهِدُكَ وَنُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ بِأَنَّكَ اللّٰه لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
meaning: O Allah we have reached morning, calling You to witness, and calling the carriers of Your Throne to witness, and Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but You, Alone, without partner, and that Muhammad (S.A.W.) is Your slave and Your Messenger.

name: Morning Remembrance 5
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
meaning: O Allah! whatever favour has come to me, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.

name: Morning Remembrance 6
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
meaning: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

name: Morning Remembrance 7
arabic: حَسۡبِیَ اللّٰہُ  لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ   ؕ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ ہُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِیۡمِ
meaning: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.

name: Morning Remembrance 8
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَاىَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and my worldly affairs. O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in You from being taken unaware from beneath me.

name: Morning Remembrance 9
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشَرَكِهِ وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
meaning: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, there is none worthy of worship except You, Lord of everything and its Owner, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk, or that I should do some evil to myself or bring it upon a Muslim.

name: Morning Remembrance 10
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ . (ثلاثاً)
meaning: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words. (three times)

name: Morning Remembrance 11
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ   وَبِحَمۡدِہِ . (مائة مرة)
meaning: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.(one hundred times)

name: Morning Remembrance 12
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ . (مائة مرة)
meaning: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. (one hundred times)

name: Morning Remembrance 13
arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ،  اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّـي أَسْأَلُكَ خَـيْرَ هَذَا الْـيَوْمِ،  فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ،  وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ،  وَهُدَاهُ،  وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
meaning: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.

name: Evening Remembrance 1
arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
meaning: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

name: Evening Remembrance 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning, and by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the Resurrection.

name: Evening Remembrance 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَمْسَيْنَا نُشْهِدُكَ وَنُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ بِأَنَّكَ اللّٰه لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
meaning: O Allah we have reached evening, calling You to witness, and calling the carriers of Your Throne to witness, and Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but You, Alone, without partner, and that Muhammad (S.A.W.) is Your slave and Your Messenger.

name: Evening Remembrance 4
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
meaning: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.

name: Evening Remembrance 5
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. (ثلاثاً إِذا أمسى)
meaning: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created. (three times in the evening)

name: Evening Remembrance 6
arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا اللَّيْلَةَ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
meaning: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 1
arabic: فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰہِ حِیۡنَ تُمۡسُوۡنَ وَ حِیۡنَ تُصۡبِحُوۡنَ وَ لَہُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَ عَشِیًّا وَّ حِیۡنَ تُظۡہِرُوۡنَ، یُخۡرِجُ الۡحَیَّ مِنَ الۡمَیِّتِ وَ یُخۡرِجُ الۡمَیِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَیِّ وَ یُحۡیِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِہَا، وَ کَذٰلِکَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
meaning: So glorify Allah [above all that (evil) they associate with Him (O believers)], when you come up to the evening [i.e. offer the (Maghrib) sunset and (‘Isha’) night prayers], and when you enter the morning [i.e offer the (Fajr) morning prayer]. And His is all the praises and thanks in the heavens and the earth, and (glorify Him) in the afternoon (i.e. offer ‘Asr prayer) and when you come up to the time, when the day begins to decline (i.e offer Zuhr prayer). (Ibn ‘Abbas said: ‘These are the five compulsory congregational prayers mentioned in the Quran).’ He brings out the living from the dead, and brings out the dead from the living. And He revives the earth after its death. And thus shall you be brought out (resurrected).

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 2
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ
meaning: Glorified is Allah and praised is He. Glorified is Allah the most great.

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 3
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ
meaning: Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 4
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ‏
meaning: Allah is free from imperfection and His is the praise

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 5
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
meaning: Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He.

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 6
arabic: ہُوَ اللّٰہُ الَّذِیۡ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ ۚ عٰلِمُ الۡغَیۡبِ وَ الشَّہَادَۃِ ۚ ہُوَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ الرَّحِیۡمُ. ہُوَ اللّٰہُ الَّذِیۡ لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ ۚ اَلۡمَلِکُ الۡقُدُّوۡسُ السَّلٰمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُ الۡمُہَیۡمِنُ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡجَبَّارُ الۡمُتَکَبِّرُ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰہِ عَمَّا یُشۡرِکُوۡنَ. ہُوَ اللّٰہُ الۡخَالِقُ الۡبَارِئُ الۡمُصَوِّرُ لَہُ الۡاَسۡمَآءُ الۡحُسۡنٰی ؕ یُسَبِّحُ لَہٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ ۚ وَ ہُوَ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ
meaning: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

name: For praising and glorifying Allah 7
arabic: مَا شَآءَ اللّٰہُ ۙ لَا قُوَّۃَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِ
meaning: What Allah willed [has occurred], there is no power except in Allah.

name: For thanking Allah 1
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللّٰهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things. There is no power and no might except by Allah . None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and we do not worship any other besides Him . His is grace, and His is bounty and to Him belongs the most excellent praise. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah . (We are) sincere in making our religious devotion to Him, even though the disbelievers may dislike it.

name: For thanking Allah 2
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
meaning: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.

name: For thanking Allah 3
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰہِ، وَالۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ، وَاللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
meaning: Glory is to Allah, praise is to Allah, Allah is the Most Great!

name: For thanking Allah 4
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ
meaning: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.

name: For thanking Allah 5
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ،  غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ،  وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ،  رَبَّنَا
meaning: Praise be to Allah abundantly and sincerely, of such a nature as is productive of blessing, is not insufficient, Abandoned, or ignored, O our lord.

name: For being grateful to Allah 1
arabic: رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِیۡۤ اَنۡ اَشۡکُرَ نِعۡمَتَکَ الَّتِیۡۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ وَ عَلٰی وَالِدَیَّ وَ اَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰہُ وَ اَصۡلِحۡ لِیۡ فِیۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ ۚؕ اِنِّیۡ تُبۡتُ اِلَیۡکَ وَ اِنِّیۡ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

name: For being grateful to Allah 2
arabic: رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِیۡۤ اَنۡ اَشۡکُرَ نِعۡمَتَکَ الَّتِیۡۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ وَ عَلٰی وَالِدَیَّ وَ اَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرۡضٰىہُ وَ اَدۡخِلۡنِیۡ بِرَحۡمَتِکَ فِیۡ عِبَادِکَ الصّٰلِحِیۡنَ
meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.

name: On hearing good news
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
meaning: Praise is to Allah by Whose grace good deeds are completed.

name: For leaving everything in the hands of Allah
arabic: قُلِ اللّٰہُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ عٰلِمَ الۡغَیۡبِ وَ الشَّہَادَۃِ اَنۡتَ تَحۡکُمُ بَیۡنَ عِبَادِکَ فِیۡ مَا کَانُوۡا فِیۡہِ یَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
meaning: Say (O Muhammad SAW): ‘O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! All-Knower of the Ghaib (unseen) and the seen. You will judge between your slaves about that wherein they used to differ.’

name: For forgiveness and Allah's mercy 1
arabic: اَنۡتَ وَلِیُّنَا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡغٰفِرِیۡنَ وَ اکۡتُبۡ لَنَا فِیۡ ہٰذِہِ الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ  اِنَّا ہُدۡنَاۤ  اِلَیۡکَ
meaning: (O my Lord) You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers. And ordain for us good in this world, and in the Hereafter. Certainly we have turned unto You.

name: For forgiveness and Allah's mercy 2
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!

name: For forgiveness and Allah's mercy 3
arabic: رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ وَ ارۡحَمۡ وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
meaning: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!

name: For forgiveness and Allah's mercy 4
arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَاۤ اَنۡفُسَنَا ٜ وَ اِنۡ لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَ تَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَکُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! We have wronged our own souls: If thou forgive us not and bestow not upon us Thy Mercy, we shall certainly be lost.

name: For forgiveness and Allah's mercy 5
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ رَحۡمَۃً وَّ ہَیِّیٔۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا رَشَدًا
meaning: Our Lord! Bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, and dispose of our affair for us in the right way!

name: For forgiveness 1
arabic: رَبِّ اِنِّیۡۤ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ اَنۡ اَسۡـَٔلَکَ مَا لَـیۡسَ لِیۡ بِہٖ عِلۡمٌ ؕ وَ اِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ تَرۡحَمۡنِیۡۤ  اَکُنۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِیۡنَ
meaning: O my Lord! I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have Mercy on me, I would indeed be one of the losers.

name: For forgiveness 2
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ  (ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ)
meaning: I ask Allah’s pardon and turn to Him in repentance. (Three Times)

name: For forgiveness 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
meaning: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.

name: For forgiveness 4
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِـرْ لي، وَتُبْ عَلَـيَّ،  إِنَّكَ أَنْـتَ التَّـوّابُ الغَـفُورُ
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.

name: Forgiveness for your siblings
arabic: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِاَخِیۡ وَ اَدۡخِلۡنَا فِیۡ رَحۡمَتِکَ وَ اَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
meaning: O my Lord! Forgive me and my brother, and make us enter into Your Mercy, for you are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

name: For asking forgiveness for yourself and anyone who enters your house
arabic: رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَیۡتِیَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ وَ الۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ وَ لَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.

name: For repentance 1
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ  إِلَهَ إلاَّ هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ
meaning: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.

name: For repentance 2
arabic: ذٰلِکُمُ اللّٰہُ رَبِّیۡ عَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ اِلَیۡہِ اُنِیۡبُ
meaning: (And say O Muhammad SAW to these polytheists:) Such is Allah, my Lord in Whom I put my trust, and to Him I turn in all of my affairs and in repentance.

name: Seek Allah's satisfaction 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّا ؕ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ السَّمِیۡعُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ
meaning: Our Lord! Accept (this service) from us: For Thou art the All-Hearing, the All-knowing.

name: Seek Allah's satisfaction 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ اجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَیۡنِ لَکَ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِنَاۤ اُمَّۃً مُّسۡلِمَۃً لَّکَ ۪ وَ اَرِنَا مَنَاسِکَنَا وَ تُبۡ عَلَیۡنَا ۚ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِیۡمُ
meaning: Our Lord! Make of us Muslims, bowing to Thy (Will), and of our progeny a people Muslim, bowing to Thy (will); and show us our place for the celebration of (due) rites; and turn unto us (in Mercy); for Thou art the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

name: For protection and help from Allah 1
arabic: قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ
meaning: He is Allah (the) One. The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He begets not nor was He begotten, and there is none equal to Him.

name: For protection and help from Allah 2
arabic: قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ
meaning: I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness, and from the evil of those who practice witchcraft when they blow in the knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies.

name: For protection and help from Allah 3
arabic: قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
meaning: I seek refuge with (Allah) the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers in the breasts of mankind, of jinns and men.

name: For protection and help from Allah 4
arabic: اَنَّ اللّٰہَ مَوۡلٰىکُمۡ ؕ نِعۡمَ الۡمَوۡلٰی وَ نِعۡمَ النَّصِیۡرُ
meaning: Know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper.

name: For protection from Satan/Shaytan
arabic: رَّبِّ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ مِنۡ ہَمَزٰتِ الشَّیٰطِیۡنِ وَ اَعُوۡذُ بِکَ رَبِّ اَنۡ یَّحۡضُرُوۡنِ
meaning: My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayatin (devils). And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they may attend (or come near) me.

name: To keep your family safe from transgressors
arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ وَ اَہۡلِیۡ مِمَّا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
meaning: My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do.

name: For your child's protection
arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
meaning: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.

name: For protection from oppressors 1
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ ہٰذِہِ الۡقَرۡیَۃِ الظَّالِمِ اَہۡلُہَا وَ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ وَلِیًّا وَّ اجۡعَلۡ لَّنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ نَصِیۡرًا
meaning: Our Lord! Rescue us from this town whose people are oppressors; and raise for us from You one who will protect, and raise for us from You one who will help.

name: For protection from oppressors 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَنَصِيرِي بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
meaning: O Allah, You are my aid ane my support. By Your defend, by You I attack and by Your I fight.

name: Protect yourself from enemies
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
meaning: Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.

name: For curbing fear 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
meaning: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.

name: For curbing fear 2
arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
meaning: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

name: Seek protection from wrongdoers
arabic: عَلَی اللّٰہِ تَوَکَّلۡنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَۃً  لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ وَ نَجِّنَا بِرَحۡمَتِکَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
meaning: Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.

name: For fear of committing Shirk
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ،  وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.

name: To be a pious Muslim 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! Place us not with the people who are Zaalimoon (polytheists and wrong doers).

name: To be a pious Muslim 2
arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِیۡ فِی الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.

name: Protection from Natural Disasters & Calamities
arabic:
[سُوۡرَةُ الإخلاص] 
 قُلۡ ہُوَ اللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ،  اَللّٰہُ الصَّمَدُ،  لَمۡ یَلِدۡ وَ لَمۡ یُوۡلَدۡوَ لَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہٗ  کُفُوًا اَحَدٌ 

[سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ 

[سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]
 قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
meaning: [Surah Al-Ikhlas] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent. [Surah Al-Falaq] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies. [Surah An-Nas] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind.

name: Daily Remembrance 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ والشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّموَاتِ والأرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ  شَیۡءٍ ومَلِيْكَهُ، أشْهَدُ أنْ لَا إلَهَ إلاَّ أنْتَ، أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
meaning: O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk.

name: Daily Remembrance 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
meaning: O Allah! I have surrendered myself over to you and have turned my face towards You, and leave all my affairs to You and depend on You and put my trust in You expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment. There is neither fleeing from You nor refuge but with You. I believe in the Book (Qur’an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent.

name: Everyday Duas 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

name: Everyday Duas 2
arabic: لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ  اِلَّاۤ اَنۡتَ سُبۡحٰنَکَ  اِنِّیۡ کُنۡتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.

name: Before starting anything
arabic: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ  الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ
meaning: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

name: For success in this world and aakhira 1
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا فِی الدُّنۡیَا حَسَنَۃً وَّ فِی الۡاٰخِرَۃِ حَسَنَۃً وَّ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
meaning: Our Lord! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the torment of the Fire!

name: For success in this world and aakhira 2
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّکَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِیَوۡمٍ لَّا رَیۡبَ فِیۡہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ لَا یُخۡلِفُ الۡمِیۡعَادَ
meaning: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.

name: For Rizq (sustenance) 1
arabic: اَللّٰہُ لَطِیۡفٌۢ بِعِبَادِہٖ یَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ یَّشَآءُ وَ ہُوَ الۡقَوِیُّ الۡعَزِیۡزُ
meaning: Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His slaves. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.

name: For Rizq (sustenance) 2
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَنۡزِلۡ عَلَیۡنَا مَآئِدَۃً مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ تَکُوۡنُ لَنَا عِیۡدًا لِّاَوَّلِنَا وَ اٰخِرِنَا وَ اٰیَۃً مِّنۡکَ ۚ وَ ارۡزُقۡنَا وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الرّٰزِقِیۡنَ
meaning: O Allah our Lord! Send us from heaven a table set (with viands), that there may be for us - for the first and the last of us - a solemn festival and a sign from thee; and provide for our sustenance, for thou art the best Sustainer (of our needs).

name: When you are in need
arabic: رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَیَّ مِنۡ خَیۡرٍ فَقِیۡرٌ
meaning: My Lord! Truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me!

name: For praising Allah
arabic: اللّٰہُمَّ مٰلِکَ الۡمُلۡکِ تُؤۡتِی الۡمُلۡکَ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تَنۡزِعُ الۡمُلۡکَ مِمَّنۡ تَشَآءُ ۫ وَ تُعِزُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ ؕ بِیَدِکَ الۡخَیۡرُ ؕ اِنَّکَ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ قَدِیۡرٌ، تُوۡلِجُ الَّیۡلَ فِی النَّہَارِ وَ تُوۡلِجُ النَّہَارَ فِی الَّیۡلِ ۫ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡحَیَّ مِنَ الۡمَیِّتِ وَ تُخۡرِجُ الۡمَیِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَیِّ ۫ وَ تَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ بِغَیۡرِ حِسَابٍ
meaning: O Allah! Possessor of the kingdom, You give the kingdom to whom You will, and You take the kingdom from whom You will, and You endue with honour whom You will, and You humiliate whom You will. In Your Hand is the good. Verily, You are Able to do all things. You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night (i.e. increase and decrease in the hours of the night and the day during winter and summer), You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give wealth and sustenance to whom You will, without limit (measure or account).

name: For success
arabic: وَ مَا تَوۡفِیۡقِیۡۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِ ؕعَلَیۡہِ تَوَکَّلۡتُ وَ اِلَیۡہِ اُنِیۡبُ
meaning: My success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.

name: When Visiting the Sick 1
arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ
meaning: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.

name: When Visiting the Sick 2
arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
meaning: I ask Allah who is the Lofty and the Lord of the Mighty Throne that He cures you (Prophet Mohammad (SAW.) said that by reciting this dua seven times, the ill person will regain his health and if death occurs then that (death) is a different issue (i.e. death is written it cannot be prevented))

name: To alleviate pain
arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللّٰهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ. (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
meaning: In the Name of Allah, I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.

name: Upon seeing someone going through a trial or tribulation
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.

name: If you fall on hard times
arabic: اَنِّیۡ مَسَّنِیَ الضُّرُّ وَ اَنۡتَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
meaning: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

name: When you are nearing your death 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى
meaning: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy upon me and join me with the highest companions (in Paradise).

name: When you are nearing your death 2
arabic: لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَاللّٰهُ اَکۡبَرُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَا شَرِيۡکَ لَهُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ لَهُ الْمُلْکُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لَا اِلٰہَ اِلَّا اللّٰہُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰہِِ
meaning: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, His is the dominion and His is the praise. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, there is no power and no might but by Allah.

name: When visiting graves
arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللّٰهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
meaning: Oh Muslims residing here, salaams on you, by the will of Allah we will also be coming to you. We seek safety for us and you.

name: During illness
arabic: [سُوۡرَةُ الفَلَق]  قُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ الۡفَلَقِ،  مِنۡ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَب،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الۡعُقَدِ،  وَ مِنۡ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ [سُوۡرَةُ  النَّاس]  ۡقُلۡ اَعُوۡذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِکِ النَّاسِ، اِلٰہِ النَّاسِ، مِنۡ شَرِّ الۡوَسۡوَاسِ الۡخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِیۡ یُوَسۡوِسُ فِیۡ صُدُوۡرِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الۡجِنَّۃِ وَ النَّاسِ
meaning: [Surah Al-Falaq]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, From the evil of that which He created, And from the evil of darkness when it settles, And from the evil of the blowers in knots, And from the evil of an envier when he envies." [Surah An-Nas]Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind."

name: For forgiveness for your parents and all Muslims
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ یَوۡمَ یَقُوۡمُ الۡحِسَابُ
meaning: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

name: Make Dua for your parents 1
arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِیۡ فَاغۡفِرۡ لِیۡ فَغَفَرَ لَہٗ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِیۡمُ، قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیَّ فَلَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ ظَہِیۡرًا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ، رَبِّ نَجِّنِیۡ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful. He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals. My Lord, save me from the wrong doing people.

name: Make Dua for your parents 2
arabic: رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مُقِیۡمَ الصَّلٰوۃِ وَ مِنۡ ذُرِّیَّتِیۡ، رَبَّنَا وَ تَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
meaning: O my Lord! Make me one who performs As-Salaat (Iqaamat-as-Salaat), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation.

name: Make Dua for your parents 3
arabic: رَّبِّ ارۡحَمۡہُمَا کَمَا رَبَّیٰنِیۡ صَغِیۡرًا
meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them (parents) as they brought me up [when i was] small.

name: For a blissful family
arabic: رَبَّنَا ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّۃَ اَعۡیُنٍ وَّ اجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِمَامًا
meaning: O my Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous.

name: Asking Allah to grant you a child 1
arabic: رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ ذُرِّیَّۃً طَیِّبَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ سَمِیۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ
meaning: O my Lord! Grant me from You, a good offspring. You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation.

name: Asking Allah to grant you a child 2
arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِیۡ فَرۡدًا وَّ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡوٰرِثِیۡنَ
meaning: O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors.

name: Say these words when in distress
arabic: اللّٰہُ اللّٰہُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
meaning: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.

name: Get a house in Jannah!
arabic: قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ابۡنِ لِیۡ عِنۡدَکَ بَیۡتًا فِی الۡجَنَّۃِ
meaning: My Lord! Build me a house in Paradise near You

name: When you fail or lose at something
arabic: قَدَّرَ اللّٰهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
meaning: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.

name: When stricken by tragedy 1
arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
meaning: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.

name: When stricken by tragedy 2
arabic: حَسۡبُنَا اللّٰہُ وَ نِعۡمَ الۡوَکِیۡلُ
meaning: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.

name: For seeking Allah's help
arabic: اِنَّمَاۤ اَشۡکُوۡا بَثِّیۡ وَ حُزۡنِیۡۤ  اِلَی اللّٰہِ وَ اَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰہِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
meaning: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.

name: At times of worry and sorry
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i .e . others).

name: When in distress 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
meaning: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.

name: When in distress 2
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
meaning: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

name: When in distress 3
arabic: يَا حَىُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
meaning: O Ever Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer! In Your Mercy do I seek relief, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

name: On hearing a bad news
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
meaning: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.

name: For patience during difficult times
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ تَوَفَّنَا مُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! pour out on us patience, and cause us to die as Muslims.

name: When someone insults you
