arabic: رَبِّ احۡکُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَ رَبُّنَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰی مَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
meaning: My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe.

name: To trust upon Allah
arabic: وَ اُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِیۡۤ اِلَی اللّٰہِ ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰہَ بَصِیۡرٌۢ بِالۡعِبَادِ
meaning: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah . Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants.

name: When someone praises you
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لا يَعْلَمُونَ‏
meaning: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of.

name: For patience
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اَفۡرِغۡ عَلَیۡنَا صَبۡرًا وَّ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.

name: When a loss occurs
arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰہِ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِلَیۡہِ رٰجِعُوۡنَ
meaning: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.

name: Settle a debt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
meaning: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.

name: For someone who lends you money
arabic: بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
meaning: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).

name: Strengthen your Imaan 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوۡبَنَا بَعۡدَ اِذۡ ہَدَیۡتَنَا وَ ہَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡکَ رَحۡمَۃً ۚ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَہَّابُ
meaning: Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate (from the truth) after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from You. Truly, You are the Bestower.

name: Strengthen your Imaan 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ اِسۡرَافَنَا فِیۡۤ اَمۡرِنَا وَ ثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَ انۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and our transgressions (in keeping our duties to You), establish our feet firmly, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

name: Strengthen your Imaan 3
arabic: اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہ
meaning: I seek refuge in Allah.

name: Strengthen your Imaan 4
arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
meaning: I believe in Allah and His Messenger.

name: To make us practicing Muslims
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ وَ اتَّبَعۡنَا الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! We believe in what Thou hast revealed, and we follow the Messenger. Then write us down among those who bear witness.

name: Seek forgiveness and strengthen your Imaan
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنَاۤ اِنۡ نَّسِیۡنَاۤ اَوۡ اَخۡطَاۡنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحۡمِلۡ عَلَیۡنَاۤ اِصۡرًا کَمَا حَمَلۡتَہٗ عَلَی الَّذِیۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلۡنَا مَا لَا طَاقَۃَ لَنَا بِہٖ، وَ اعۡفُ عَنَّا، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا، وَ ارۡحَمۡنَا، اَنۡتَ مَوۡلٰىنَا فَانۡصُرۡنَا عَلَی الۡقَوۡمِ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error, our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which You did lay on those before us; our Lord! Put not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Pardon us and grant us Forgiveness. Have mercy on us. You are our Maula (Patron, Supporter and Protector, etc.) and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

name: Pledge to Allah 1
arabic: اِنِّیۡ وَجَّہۡتُ وَجۡہِیَ لِلَّذِیۡ فَطَرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضَ حَنِیۡفًا وَّ مَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِکِیۡنَ
meaning: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah.

name: Pledge to Allah 2
arabic: اِنَّ صَلَاتِیۡ وَ نُسُکِیۡ وَ مَحۡیَایَ وَ مَمَاتِیۡ  لِلّٰہِ  رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ لَا شَرِیۡکَ لَہٗ، وَ بِذٰلِکَ اُمِرۡتُ وَ اَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡمُسۡلِمِیۡنَ
meaning: Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims.

name: For righteous company 1
arabic: فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الۡاَرۡضِ ۟ اَنۡتَ وَلِیّٖ فِی الدُّنۡیَا وَ الۡاٰخِرَۃِ ۚ تَوَفَّنِیۡ مُسۡلِمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ
meaning: Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

name: For righteous company 2
arabic: رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاکۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰہِدِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! We believe; write us down among the witnesses.

name: Increase in knowledge 1
arabic: رَّبِّ زِدۡنِیۡ عِلۡمًا
meaning: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.

name: Increase in knowledge 2
arabic: رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ حُکۡمًا وَّ اَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ، وَ اجۡعَلۡ لِّیۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِی الۡاٰخِرِیۡنَ، وَ اجۡعَلۡنِیۡ مِنۡ وَّرَثَۃِ جَنَّۃِ النَّعِیۡمِ، وَ اغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِیۡۤ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّیۡنَ، وَ لَا تُخۡزِنِیۡ یَوۡمَ یُبۡعَثُوۡنَ، یَوۡمَ لَا یَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّ لَا بَنُوۡنَ، اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَی اللّٰہَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِیۡمٍ
meaning: My Lord! Bestow Hukman (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous. And grant me an honourable mention in later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure. And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray. And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected. The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.

name: Grant me confidence and eloquence 1
arabic: رَبِّ اشۡرَحۡ لِیۡ صَدۡرِیۡ، وَ یَسِّرۡ لِیۡۤ اَمۡرِیۡ، وَ احۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَۃً  مِّنۡ لِّسَانِیۡ، یَفۡقَہُوۡا قَوۡلِیۡ
meaning: O my Lord! Open for me my chest. And ease my task for me.  And make loose the knot from my tongue, that they understand my speech.

name: Grant me confidence and eloquence 2
arabic: سُبۡحٰنَکَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَاۤ اِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَا ؕ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَلِیۡمُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ
meaning: Glory be to You, we have no knowledge except what you have taught us. Verily, it is You, the All-Knower, the All-Wise.

name: For protection from ignorance
arabic: اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰہِ اَنۡ اَکُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰہِلِیۡنَ
meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant.

name: Seek forgiveness and protection from hell 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ کُلَّ شَیۡءٍ رَّحۡمَۃً وَّ عِلۡمًا فَاغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِیۡنَ تَابُوۡا وَ اتَّبَعُوۡا سَبِیۡلَکَ وَ قِہِمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِیۡمِ
meaning: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

name: Seek forgiveness and protection from hell 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ ہٰذَا بَاطِلًا ۚ سُبۡحٰنَکَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ، رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّکَ مَنۡ تُدۡخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدۡ اَخۡزَیۡتَہٗ، وَ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِیۡنَ مِنۡ اَنۡصَارٍ، رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِیًا یُّنَادِیۡ لِلۡاِیۡمَانِ اَنۡ اٰمِنُوۡا بِرَبِّکُمۡ فَاٰمَنَّا ٭ۖ رَبَّنَا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَ کَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَیِّاٰتِنَا وَ تَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ، رَبَّنَا وَ اٰتِنَا مَا وَعَدۡتَّنَا عَلٰی رُسُلِکَ وَ لَا تُخۡزِنَا یَوۡمَ الۡقِیٰمَۃِ، اِنَّکَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ الۡمِیۡعَادَ
meaning: Our Lord! You have not created (all) this without purpose, glory to You! (Exalted be You above all that they associate with You as partners). Give us salvation from the torment of the Fire. *Our Lord! Verily, whom You admit to the Fire, indeed, You have disgraced him, and never will the Zaalimoon (polytheists and wrong-doers) find any helpers. *Our Lord! Verily, we have heard the call of one (Muhammad p.b.u.h.) calling to Faith: ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we have believed. *Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die in the state of righteousness along with Al-Abraar (those who are obedient to Allah and follow strictly His Orders). *Our Lord! Grant us what You promised unto us through Your Messengers and disgrace us not on the Day of Resurrection, for You never break (Your) Promise.

name: For Jannah 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا اصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَہَنَّمَ ٭ۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَہَا کَانَ غَرَامًا، اِنَّہَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا
meaning: Our Lord! Avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,- Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

name: For Jannah 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَ اَدۡخِلۡہُمۡ جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِۣ الَّتِیۡ وَعَدۡتَّہُمۡ وَ مَنۡ صَلَحَ مِنۡ اٰبَآئِہِمۡ وَ اَزۡوَاجِہِمۡ وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِہِمۡ، اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡحَکِیۡمُ وَ قِہِمُ السَّیِّاٰتِ وَ مَنۡ تَقِ السَّیِّاٰتِ یَوۡمَئِذٍ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَہٗ وَ ذٰلِکَ ہُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِیۡمُ
meaning: Our Lord! And make them enter the ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens) which you have promised them, and to the righteous among their fathers, their wives, and their offspring! Verily, You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise. And save them from (the punishment, because of what they did of) the sins, and whomsoever You save from (the punishment, because of what they did of) the sins (i.e. excuse them) that Day, him verily, You have taken into mercy.’ And that is the supreme success.’

name: Talbiyah
arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
meaning: Ever at Your service, O Allah, every at Your service. Ever at Your Service, You have no partner, ever at Your service. Verily all praise, blessings and dominions are Yours. You have no partner.

name: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كَلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
meaning: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.

name: For reciting at Al-Mash'ar Al-Haraam (Muzdalifah)
arabic: اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ، اَللّٰہُ اَحَدٌ، لَّاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّاۤ اللّٰہُ
meaning: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is One. There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

name: At Arafat
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
meaning: None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

name: When sacrificing an animal
arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰہِ، اَللّٰہُ اَکۡبَرُ
meaning: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great

name: While going to Mount Safa
arabic: اِنَّ الصَّفَا وَ الۡمَرۡوَۃَ مِنۡ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰہِ
meaning: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

name: On the sighting of the crescent moon
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهْلِلْهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللّٰهُ
meaning: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and security and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah

name: For the night of destiny (Lailatul Qadr)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
meaning: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, [Generous,] You love pardon, so pardon me

name: When offering condolence
arabic: إِنَّ لِلّٰهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
meaning: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time. So, have patience and be rewarded.

name: When closing the eyes of the deceased
arabic: اللَّهمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلانٍ (باسْمِهِ)، وارْفَعْ دَرَجَتهُ فِي الـمَهْدِيِّيْنَ، واخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الغَابِريْنَ، واغْفِرْ لَـنَا ولَهُ يَا رَبَّ العَالَـمِيْنَ، وافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيْهِ
meaning: O Allah, forgive [name of the deceased person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave and shed light upon him in it.

name: For the deceased at the funeral prayer 1
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
meaning: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him and give him strength and pardon him. Be generous to him and cause his entrance to be wide and wash him with water and snow and hail. Cleanse him of his transgressions as white cloth is cleansed of stains. Give him an abode better than his home, and a family better than his family and a wife better than his wife. Take him into Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave [and from the punishment of Hell-fire].

name: For the deceased at the funeral prayer 2
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
meaning: O Allah forgive our living and our dead, those who are with us and those who are absent, our young and our old, our menfolk and our womenfolk. O Allah, whomever you give life from among us give him life in Islam, and whomever you take way from us take him away in Faith. O Allah, do not forbid us their reward and do not send us astray after them.

name: For the deceased at the funeral prayer 3
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ {فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ} فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
meaning: O Allah, surely [name the person] is under Your protection, and in the rope of Your security, so save him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the Fire. You fulfill promises and grant rights, so forgive him and have mercy on him. Surely You are Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

name: When placing the deceased in the grave
arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
meaning: With the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah

name: For rain
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعاً نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
meaning: O Allah! give us rain which will replenish us, abundant, fertilising and profitable, not injurious, granting it now without delayd not delayed.

name: When it rains
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
meaning: O Allah, make it beneficial rain.

name: After rainfall
arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللّٰهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
meaning: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

name: When there is excessive rain
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَر
meaning: O Allah, let it pass us and not fall upon us, but upon the hills and mountains, and the center of the valleys, and upon the forested lands.

name: Upon hearing thunder
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَقْتُلْنَا بِغَضَبِكَ وَلَا تُهْلِكْنَا بِعَذَابِكَ وَعَافِنَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ
meaning: O Allah, do not kill us with Your wrath, and do not destroy us with Your punishment, and pardon us before that.

name: During a windstorm
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
meaning: O Allah, indeed, I ask You for its good, the good of what is in it, and the good of what it has been sent with. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what it has been sent with.

name: For greeting people
arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
meaning: May the peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you

name: When responding to Salam
arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
meaning: Peace and mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you

name: For thanking someone
arabic: جَزَاكَ اللّٰهُ خَيْرًا
meaning: May Allah reward you with good.

name: Upon sneezing
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ
meaning: All praise is for Allah.

name: Upon hearing someone sneeze
arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰهُ
meaning: May Allah have mercy upon you

name: When entering the marketplace
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٍ
meaning: There is no Lord except Allah. He is One and has no partners. His is the Kingdom and for Him are all praises. He gives life and gives death. He is eternal and everlasting In His control is goodness, and He has power over everything.

name: At the end of a Gathering/Majlis
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
meaning: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

name: Sneezers replies back
arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
meaning: May Allah guide you and set right your affairs.

name: For Istikhara
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،  وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ،  فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ،  اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ  أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ  فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ،  وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ  أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ  فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ،  وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
meaning: O Allah, I seek the counsel of Your Knowledge, and I seek the help of Your Omnipotence, and I beseech You for Your Magnificent Grace. Surely, You are Capable and I am not. You know and I know not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter [then mention the thing to be decided] is good for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come, - [or say: in this life and the afterlife] - then ordain it for me and make it easy for me, then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come, - [or say: in this life and the afterlife] - then distance it from me, and distance me from it, and ordain for me what is good wherever it may be, and help me to be content with it. Whoever seeks the counsel of the Creator will not regret it and whoever seeks the advice of the believers will feel confident about his decisions. Allah said in the Qur’an: ‘And consult them in the affair. Then when you have taken a decision, put your trust in Allah.’

name: Get justice in this world
arabic: رَبَّنَا افۡتَحۡ بَیۡنَنَا وَ بَیۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَ اَنۡتَ خَیۡرُ الۡفٰتِحِیۡنَ
meaning: Our Lord! Decide Thou between us and our people in truth, for Thou art the best to decide.

name: Seek Allah's guidance 1
arabic: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰہِ الَّذِیۡ ہَدٰىنَا لِہٰذَا ۟ وَ مَا کُنَّا لِنَہۡتَدِیَ لَوۡ لَاۤ اَنۡ ہَدٰىنَا اللّٰہُ
meaning: Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us.

name: Seek Allah's guidance 2
arabic: فَاللّٰہُ خَیۡرٌ حٰفِظًا وَّ ہُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیۡنَ
meaning: Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
meaning: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 3
arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى القَوْمِ الكَافِرِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, plant firmly our feet, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 4
arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
meaning: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 5
arabic: رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡلِي وَلِأَخِى وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِى رَحۡمَتِكَ‌ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٲحِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 6
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 7
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

name: Seeking Forgiveness for Sins 8
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖ رَّحۡمَةٗ وَعِلۡمٗا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
meaning: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.

name: Acknowledging Wrongdoing 1
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ۥ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meaning: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

name: Acknowledging Wrongdoing 2
arabic: لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
meaning: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

name: Protection from Hellfire 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
meaning: Our Lord, You did not create this [universe] in vain. Exalted are You! So protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

name: Protection from Hellfire 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
meaning: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.

name: Protection from Hellfire 3
arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
meaning: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is a lasting torment. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.

name: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers 1
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلظَّالِمِ أَهۡلُهَاۤ وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّ۬ا وَٱجۡعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
meaning: Our Lord, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper.

name: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا مَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

name: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers 3
arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِى فِى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, do not place me among the wrongdoing people.

name: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers 4
arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

name: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers 5
arabic: رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people.

name: Protection from Oppressors & Wrongdoers 6
arabic: اِنِّيْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
meaning: Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account.

name: Seeking Ease in Affairs 1
arabic: رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِى صَدۡرِى ٢٥ وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِى ٢٦ وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةً۬ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧ يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِىٓ ٢٨
meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

name: Seeking Ease in Affairs 2
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.

name: For Righteous Children 1
arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً۬ طَيِّبَةً‌ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
meaning: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

name: For Righteous Children 2
arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
meaning: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.

name: For Parents 1
arabic: رََّبِّ ٱرۡحَمۡهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

name: For Parents 2
arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنً۬ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَـٰرًا
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.

name: For Family's Faith & Righteousness 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
meaning: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

name: For Family's Faith & Righteousness 2
arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنً۬ا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ
meaning: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure, and keep me and my children away from worshipping idols.

name: For Family's Faith & Righteousness 3
arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٲلِدَىَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَـٰلِحً۬ا تَرۡضَٮٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ إِنِّى تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

name: Seeking Patience & Steadfastness
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَى
meaning: Our Lord, indeed we fear that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.

name: Seeking Victory & Justice 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَ قَوۡمِنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡفَٰتِحِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

name: Seeking Victory & Justice 2
arabic: رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
meaning: My Lord, support me against the corrupting people.

name: Declaration of Faith & Obedience 1
arabic: سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۤ‌ غُفۡرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
meaning: We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination.

name: Declaration of Faith & Obedience 2
arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
meaning: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.

name: Declaration of Faith & Obedience 3
arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

name: Declaration of Faith & Obedience 4
arabic: رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَن نَّدۡعُوَاْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَـٰهً۬ا‌ لَّقَدۡ قُلۡنَآ إِذً۬ا شَطَطً۬آ
meaning: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then an excessive transgression.

name: Declaration of Faith & Obedience 5
arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
meaning: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

name: Goodness in Both Worlds 1
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
meaning: Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.

name: Goodness in Both Worlds 2
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
meaning: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

name: Goodness in Both Worlds 3
arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ
meaning: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise. And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds].

name: Gratitude & Mercy 1
arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
meaning: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

name: Gratitude & Mercy 2
arabic: رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٲلِدَىَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَـٰلِحً۬ا تَرۡضَٮٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِى بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

name: Gratitude & Mercy 3
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
meaning: Our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative.

name: Gratitude & Mercy 4
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ
meaning: Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

name: Seeking Protection from Trials
arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
meaning: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who have disbelieved. And forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

name: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas 1
arabic: فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأَخِرَةِ‌ تَوَفَّنِى مُسۡلِمً۬ا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
meaning: ˹O˺ Originator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Guardian in this world and the Hereafter. Allow me to die as one who submits and join me with the righteous.

name: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas 2
arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَى عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
meaning: Our Lord, You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.

name: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas 3
arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلۡوَٲرِثِينَ
meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.

name: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas 4
arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلً۬ا مُّبَارَكً۬ا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ
meaning: My Lord, cause me to land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].

name: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas 5
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَىَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ فَقِيرٌ
meaning: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

name: Miscellaneous Quranic Duas 6
arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, send down upon us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.

name: Prayer for a Just Decision
arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
meaning: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, for You are the best of judges.

name: Prayer for Mercy for Family
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy. You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

name: Prayer of Prophet Yusuf
arabic: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
meaning: My Lord, You gave me authority and taught me interpretation. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my Guardian in this world and the Hereafter. Let me die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

name: Prayer for a Safe City and Pure Worship
arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَنْ نَعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
meaning: My Lord, make this city secure and keep me and my children away from worshipping idols.

name: Prayer for Better Guidance
arabic: عَسَىٰ أَنْ يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّي لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَٰذَا رَشَدًا
meaning: May my Lord guide me to what is nearer to the right course than this.

name: Prayer in Weakness and Old Age
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
meaning: My Lord, my bones have grown weak and my hair has turned grey, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You.

name: Prayer for a Blessed Landing
arabic: رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ
meaning: My Lord, let me land at a blessed place, for You are the best to provide a landing.

name: Prayer for Protection from Wrongdoers
arabic: رَبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
meaning: My Lord, if You show me what they are promised, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.

name: Prayer for Rescue with the Believers
arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَنْ مَعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meaning: My Lord, my people have denied me. Judge decisively between us, and save me and the believers with me.

name: Prayer to Save My Family
arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
meaning: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.

name: Prayer for Righteous Offspring
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
meaning: My Lord, grant me righteous offspring.

name: Prayer for Relief from Punishment
arabic: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
meaning: Our Lord, remove the punishment from us; indeed, we are believers.
